basic.name: Sandra Chaparro
basic.summary: Software engineer with a full-stack background, now building focused expertise in application security, threat intelligence, OSINT, threat hunting, and AI security.
basic.about: I'm a software engineer based in the Dallas–Fort Worth area with a full-stack background spanning healthcare EHR platforms, dashboards, and client web products. I'm now transitioning into cybersecurity — grounded in real application security work I've done in production (authentication, authorization, and protecting sensitive data), and building focused knowledge in threat intelligence, OSINT, threat hunting, and AI security through certification study and self-directed learning. I care about technology that actually helps people, and I bring a developer's instincts to security problems: curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning in public.

Maintained CI/CD workflows with Git-based version control and implemented security best practices within a 3-tier architecture.
Integrated the DocuSign eSignature API using C# and JWT authentication, automating document signing workflows.
Developed custom ERP client solutions, including BAQ reports, for a range of clients including ITAR-regulated organizations.
